name: describe_analysis
description: Structure of the QuickSight analysis the chat panel is embedded in: sheets, visuals (visual_id, type, title, the fields each one plots), parameters with their control titles and default values, which dataset columns each parameter filters, dataset ids, and the columns of each dataset. The summary is usually already in your instructions; call this only when you need it refreshed.

_caller.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

_analysis.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

_parameters.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

name: preview_analysis_change
description: Prepare (do not apply) one edit of the analysis. The chat page shows a preview with an apply button; only the user's button press changes the analysis. Only users who can edit the analysis in QuickSight are allowed.

operation.description: change_chart_type, set_title, set_measures, set_category, set_color, sort, add_visual or delete_visual.

visual_id.description: Visual to edit (all operations except add_visual).

agg.description: sum, avg, min, max, count or count_distinct.

grain.description: For date columns: year, quarter, month, week, day or hour.

color.description: Series split (set_color, add_visual); omit in set_color to remove it.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier (a key of datasets in the analysis summary) for add_visual; default the first.

sheet_id.description: Sheet for add_visual; default the first.

_caller.description: Filled in by the system. Never set it.

name: undo_last_visual_change
description: Undo the most recent applied change to this analysis by restoring the definition saved before it. Refuses when the analysis was edited again afterwards, unless force is true (only when the user explicitly asks, e.g. 强制撤销).

force.description: Overwrite later edits too. Only when the user explicitly says so.
